statement: The grid is a list of equal-length strings in which '#' is a blocked cell and '.' is open. Find the fewest moves from the top-left cell (row 0, column 0) to the bottom-right cell (last row, last column). A move goes from a cell to any of its 8 neighbours (horizontal, vertical or diagonal) that is open. Return -1 if the grid is empty, if either corner is blocked, or if the bottom-right cell cannot be reached. A 1x1 open grid needs 0 moves. The grid is a list of strings that all have the same length; the list may be empty, and its rows may be empty strings.
